summary: Connect CI/CD security checks with audit trails, release controls and compliance evidence. Explore practical DevSecOps training for regulated teams.
lede: Compliance-by-design DevSecOps training helps delivery, security and compliance teams connect CI/CD controls with auditable release evidence. Participants map secure-development controls to pipeline activities, define security-gate and exception decisions, and document build provenance. They also examine release authority, separation of duties and audit trails, producing control maps, evidence registers and an assurance roadmap for regulated delivery.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who shape, operate or review software delivery controls where release evidence and security accountability matter.
modules: Regulated Delivery Risk and Control Boundaries
prerequisites: Working familiarity with software delivery or CI/CD workflows and basic information security controls is recommended. Coding is not required for the course exercises, which focus on control mapping, evidence records and release decisions.
